title: The Scarlet Line in the Window

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Forty years after Egypt, the children of Israel were camped across the Jordan from Jericho. Moses had died, and Joshua was leading them now. Before they crossed, Joshua sent two men to look the land over.

verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Rahab's house was built right into the city wall. Folks came and went. Two strangers might not be noticed there. But somebody noticed.

verses.text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

verses.text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying,

segments.speaker: king
segments.text: Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Church, Rahab had a choice to make, and no time to make it. She could turn those men in and stay on the king's good side. Instead, she hid them.

verses.text: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

verses.text: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

verses.text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

segments.text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The king's men took off running toward the river. Up on that roof, under the flax laid out to dry, the spies lay still and quiet.

verses.text: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

verses.text: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

verses.text: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: When I say God is good, you say, all the time. God is good. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "All the time"] And all the time. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "God is good"] Rahab heard what he had done, and she believed.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: She never saw the Red Sea open up. She only heard about it, same as everybody else in Jericho. Everybody else heard it and trembled. Rahab heard it and believed. Your God is God up in heaven and down here on earth. That is a confession of faith, from a woman nobody expected it from.

verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

segments.speaker: rahab
segments.text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

verses.text: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

segments.speaker: rahab
segments.text: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: And she did not just ask for herself. She asked for her daddy and her mama, her brothers and her sisters, and everything they had. She was standing in the gap for her whole family.

verses.text: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

segments.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: men
segments.text: Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

verses.text: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: In the dark, she let them down the outside of the wall on a rope, and told them to hide in the mountains three days until the search was over.

verses.text: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.

verses.text: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

segments.text: And she said,

segments.speaker: rahab

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: She did not wait. As soon as they were gone, that scarlet line went up in her window.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The city knew Rahab by her past. God knew her by her faith. She was kept safe when Jericho fell, she lived among Israel the rest of her days, and the book of Matthew lists her in the family line of King David and of Jesus himself. Do not let anybody tell you that you are too far outside for God to bring you in.

first_reader.note: Written by Claude in the landing session, then Claude's pastor and cultural read.

pastor.note: Faithful to Josh 2:1-21; Rahab in Christ's line is Matt 1:5 and her faith Heb 11:31, in words; her trade left in the stored verse; v11 confessed in our own words (no typed verse).

cultural.note: Rahab honoured as a woman of faith who stood in the gap for her family; never a joke about her past.
